title: 4 Days in Berlin - Quick Summary
items: **The first three days are a solved problem.** Historic centre, divided city, one museum plus one neighbourhood. The fourth day is the one with no default, and it decides how the trip is remembered.
**The real cost of a day out is twice the travel time plus the minimum time on the ground.** Compare that against the hours between leaving your hotel and dinner, not against the hours in the day.

**Sachsenhausen is 52 minutes away and still fits a shorter day than the Wannsee**, because three hours at the memorial is a complete visit while three hours at a lake is not. Distance is rarely the constraint.

**Potsdam needs a full day.** S7 to Potsdam Hbf in 42 minutes plus about 16 on the bus, five hours on the ground, an ABC ticket, and a timed slot booked online. Sanssouci Palace ticket 14 euros, sanssouci+ 22 euros, closed Mondays.
**Sachsenhausen Memorial is free**, about 45 minutes north by S1 or RB32 plus seven minutes on bus 804, open 08:30 to 18:00 until 26 October and 08:30 to 16:30 after that.

**Under five hours, stay inside Berlin.** Tempelhofer Feld (19 minutes, free), Charlottenburg (24 minutes, palace 12 euros), Köpenick (25 minutes on the S3) or four slow hours in one Museum Island collection.

**Check the weekday before anything else.** Sanssouci, Charlottenburg and most of Museum Island close on Mondays, which removes three of the eight options from a Monday. Travel times checked on the live VBB API on 4 September 2026.
